title: fix(fields): an empty currency box shows the field's own placeholder, or none, instead of 0.00 (#27398)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：金额输入框为空时不再显示占位符「0.00」（百分比输入框的「0」同样去掉），只显示字段自己声明的占位符，没有就留空。公开表单、记录表单、表格内联编辑三处都生效。
- 为什么改：HotCRM 的「联系我们」公开表单里，没人填的「年收入」看起来像已经填了 0；日元这类无小数的币种还被提示两位小数。
- 风险与回滚：一行改动，形状与数字字段（NumberField）一致；字段自带的占位符、表单行覆盖的占位符、真实的 0 都照旧显示。回滚即还原这一行。
- 先看：`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/CurrencyField.tsx`（placeholder 那一行）；`ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/CurrencyField.emptyPlaceholder-27398.test.tsx`；`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.currencyPlaceholder-27398.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/CurrencyField.emptyPlaceholder-27398.test.tsx apps/console/src/components/FormPage.currencyPlaceholder-27398.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件 10 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27398
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Row 2 of #27398 (row 1 is #27606; row 3 is carded, see Acceptance notes).

- `CurrencyField` (edit mode) passed `placeholder={field.placeholder || '0.00'}` to its number input, so an empty optional amount with no declared placeholder showed `0.00`, which reads as a filled-in zero. An authored empty placeholder was replaced by `0.00` too, and a zero-decimal currency (JPY) was offered a two-decimal stand-in. It now passes the field's own `placeholder`, or none, the same shape `NumberField` has.
- One change point covers every host: the public form page (`FormPage`, through the lazy field-widget registry, handing the row's merged placeholder), the record form (the form renderer's `currency` widget) and the grid's inline editor (`FieldEditWidget`) all draw this widget with the field they were handed. No host passes a placeholder of its own that the old fallback was standing in for.
- Hosts that relied on the `0.00` hint, measured on `origin/main` at 4a5396b8: none. No test, e2e spec, doc or README asserts it; the only `0.00` placeholders in the tree are authored ones (`ui/examples/schema-catalog` currency and number samples, a FlowRunner `number` field fixture), and an authored placeholder is still shown.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/fields` patch.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/CurrencyField.emptyPlaceholder-27398.test.tsx` (7 cases): the widget with no placeholder, with JPY, with an authored empty placeholder, two controls (authored placeholder shown, a real zero shown as a value), and the two package hosts: the form renderer and `FieldEditWidget`.
- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.currencyPlaceholder-27398.test.tsx` (3 cases): the real public route `/f/:slug` over a served payload: an empty optional amount has no placeholder; controls for the object field's placeholder and the form row's override.

- New files: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 10 passed (10)`.

The 6 reds are every no-placeholder pin across the widget, both package hosts and the public form; the 4 greens are the controls.

## Acceptance notes

Per-row disposition of #27398 rows 2–3, re-measured on `origin/main` at 4a5396b8:

| Row | Bucket | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| 2 · empty currency shows `0.00` | TAKE | This PR. |
| 3a · thank-you text cannot name the created record | CARD (spec, then server) | The thank-you `title` / `message` are plain strings with no template slot, and `POST /api/v1/forms/:slug/submit` answers `{ id }` only on purpose: the form-routes comment says the stored row can carry values an elevated hook derived from records the anonymous grant may never read, so the answer echoes nothing the insert stored. Naming a case number re-opens that trade-off, which is a contract decision, not a renderer change. |
| 3b · `submitBehavior` text is not translated | CARD (spec) | Not ui-only. The translation bundle's `_views.VIEW` entry (strict) declares `label`, `description`, `title`, `emptyState` and `bulkActions`, and no `submitBehavior` copy; `translateView` overlays only `bulkActionDefs`, `sections` and `title`. The public form door already serves the translated view config under `Accept-Language`, and the page reads `form.submitBehavior` from it, so a spec-side key plus overlay reaches both form pages with no ui change. |

The seat filed both cards: 3a is #28005, 3b is #28004. `PercentField` fell back to the placeholder `0` the same way; on the seat's rework it is fixed here too, as one line in `PercentField.tsx` pinned by `PercentField.emptyPlaceholder-27398.test.tsx`, and the changeset names it.
